questions.topic: Emergency safety incident storage without consent
questions.question: When the safety filter triggers (911/ER emergency), we store a de-identified truncated chat history and IP lock record in MongoDB without explicit user consent. Is this covered under HIPAA emergency exception? Do we need a disclosure notice?
questions.current_behavior: System stores de-identified incident record (IP, trigger message truncated to 500 chars, chat history truncated to 300 chars per message) in dev_Safety.emergency_incidents. No consent asked.
questions.risk: Medium - currently operating under assumption that HIPAA emergency exception applies

questions.topic: De-identification adequacy for HIPAA Safe Harbor
questions.question: Is our LLM-based deIdentify() function (Claude Haiku) sufficient to meet HIPAA Safe Harbor requirements? The function removes names, geographic identifiers, dates, phone, email, SSN, etc. but relies on LLM judgment rather than rule-based scrubbing.
questions.current_behavior: deIdentify() sends chat history to Claude Haiku with HIPAA Safe Harbor instructions. LLM returns scrubbed content. No validation that all 18 Safe Harbor identifiers are actually removed.
questions.risk: High - LLM may miss identifiers, no automated verification

questions.question: When a user consents to verbatim storage, the consent exchange is stored as part of chat_history. Is this sufficient as evidence of consent, or do we need a separate signed consent record?
questions.current_behavior: Consent question and user answer stored inline in chat_history array. No separate consent record or timestamp.
questions.risk: Medium - may not meet evidentiary standard for consent

license_agreement.licensor: National Library of Medicine (NLM), Department of Health and Human Services
license_agreement.cost: No charges, usage fees, or royalties (Section 2)

key_terms.grant: Right to use UMLS Metathesaurus and incorporate its content in computer applications designed to improve access to biomedical information (Section 1)
key_terms.distribution_restriction: Prohibited from distributing UMLS or subsets EXCEPT as integral part of applications developed for a purpose other than redistribution (Section 3)
key_terms.notification: Must inform NLM prior to distributing any application using UMLS Metathesaurus (Section 4)
key_terms.annual_report: Within 30 days of end of calendar year, provide NLM brief report on usefulness of UMLS (Section 5)
key_terms.no_warranty: NLM makes no warranties express or implied. Licensee holds NLM free from liability (Section 6)
key_terms.attribution: Must acknowledge NLM as source, citing year and version. May NOT imply NLM endorses the product (Section 10)
key_terms.copyright_notice_required: Must display: 'Some material in the UMLS Metathesaurus is from copyrighted sources of the respective copyright holders...' before providing user access (Section 11a)
key_terms.no_alteration: Prohibited from altering UMLS content, but may include content from other sources alongside it (Section 11b)
key_terms.source_identifiers: Must include identifiers so original source vocabularies can be determined (Section 11c)
key_terms.termination: 30 days written notice by either party. Failure to abide by terms is grounds for termination (Section 15)

source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.ICD10CM: Category 4 restrictions for US users — use restricted to US by employees/contractors/clients for healthcare, public health, research, educational, or statistical use. May distribute in US only, in combination with other UMLS content.
source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.SNOMED_CT: Appendix 2 SNOMED CT Affiliate License applies — perpetual worldwide non-exclusive license. May incorporate into Licensee Products. Must include SNOMED CT attribution notice. English law governs.
source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.CPT: Category 3 — internal use only for research, product development, statistical analysis. Expressly excludes routine patient data creation, public internet systems, publishing. Must display AMA copyright notice.
source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.RxNorm: Category 0 — general license terms only, no additional restrictions.
source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.LOINC: Must display Regenstrief Institute copyright notice. LOINC registered trademark.
source_restrictions_relevant_to_chatheal.MeSH: Category 0 for English. Category 3 for translations.

compliance_obligations: Display copyright notice before user access to any UMLS-derived content
Submit annual usage report to NLM by January 30 each year
Notify NLM before distributing any application using UMLS
Include SNOMED CT attribution on all media containing SNOMED CT content
DO NOT use CPT codes in any consumer-facing product — Category 3 restricts to internal use only. Separate AMA commercial license required for public use.
Include LOINC Regenstrief copyright notice if LOINC codes are used
Do not alter UMLS content — may add our own alongside it
Do not imply NLM endorsement of ChatHealthy
Geo-fence US-only vocabularies (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT US) to US users only
Do not expose raw or extractable UMLS vocabulary data via API or UI

gpt_review.verdict: Approved with CPT restriction. RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT US, LOINC, MeSH all usable for our crosswalk. CPT CANNOT be shown to consumers without separate AMA license.
